method: numerical search of this atlas: orbit elimination without symmetry (group c1) with code/sym_elim.py, started from CA-T3-30-1369-PI-MPC and removing one node; nodes kept in the closed domain; proven with tools/verify_rigorous.py
author: Claude (Anthropic), commissioned and directed by Joerg Kubitz

reproduce.command: mkdir -p out30 && python3 -c "import json,numpy as np;r=json.load(open('rules/minimal_pointcount_for_degree_n_PI/tetra/CA-T3-30-1369-PI-MPC.json'));np.save('out30/start.npy',np.c_[np.array(r['nodes']),np.array(r['weights'])])" && cd code && MI=40 NCAND=8 EXTTOL=1e-5 EXTIT=150 python3 sym_elim.py c1 30 2400 6303 ../out30/start.npy --out ../out30
